entries.cmd: oc import-image shop:1.0 --from=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/httpd-24:latest --confirm >/dev/null && oc get istag shop:1.0 -o jsonpath='{.image.dockerImageReference}{"\n"}'

oc create configmap shop-page --from-literal=index.html='

shop 1.0

oc run copier --image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/skopeo:latest --restart=Never --overrides='{"spec":{"serviceAccountName":"builder"}}' --command -- sleep 900 && oc wait pod/copier --for=condition=Ready --timeout=180s

oc exec copier -- sh -c 'skopeo copy --quiet --src-cert-dir=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount --src-registry-token="$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)" docker://image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000/$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace)/shop:1.0 oci-archive:/tmp/shop-1.0.tar && ls -lh /tmp/shop-1.0.tar'
oc exec copier -- cat /tmp/shop-1.0.tar > shop-1.0.tar && ls -lh shop-1.0.tar && skopeo inspect --format '{{.Architecture}} {{len .Layers}} layers' oci-archive:shop-1.0.tar

entries.cmd: oc new-project lab-shop-restore --skip-config-write >/dev/null && oc run copier -n lab-shop-restore --image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/skopeo:latest --restart=Never --overrides='{"spec":{"serviceAccountName":"builder"}}' --command -- sleep 900 && oc wait pod/copier -n lab-shop-restore --for=condition=Ready --timeout=180s

oc exec -i copier -n lab-shop-restore -- sh -c 'cat > /tmp/shop-1.0.tar' < shop-1.0.tar && oc exec copier -n lab-shop-restore -- sh -c 'skopeo copy --quiet --dest-cert-dir=/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount --dest-registry-token="$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token)" oci-archive:/tmp/shop-1.0.tar docker://image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000/lab-shop-restore/shop:1.0' && oc get istag shop:1.0 -n lab-shop-restore
